## Where to find and how to farm for Salt, Pepper, and Spices in Fallout 76: The Mire

Dedicated to Sergeant. Thank you for once again breaking my heart. Speaking with you is bittersweet every time </3 XD There are two types of condiment spawns in Fallout 76. One is a fixed spawn, for example, Pepper will always spawn at that location. The other type of spawn is an "Any spawn". An "Any" spawn can be either Salt, Pepper, Sugar, or Spices.
